hero.description: From personalized travel planning to unforgettable outdoor adventures, we make every journey simple, meaningful, and memorable.
hero.imageAlt: Travelers exploring a beautiful mountain destination

section.description: Discover travel services designed around your interests, your schedule, and the experiences you want to remember.

services.title: Customized Trip Planning
services.subtitle: Your journey, your way
services.shortDescription: Personalized itineraries designed around your travel style, budget, and dream destinations.
services.description: Every traveler has a different idea of the perfect holiday. We help you turn your travel ideas into a personalized itinerary, with carefully selected destinations, activities, travel routes, and schedules that suit your preferences.
services.imageAlt: Travelers planning a personalized holiday with a map
features: Family, couple, and group trip planning
Flexible schedules based on your preferences
benefits: A trip tailored to your interests
More time to enjoy meaningful experiences

services.title: Adventure & Nature Trips
services.subtitle: Find your next adventure
services.shortDescription: Explore scenic landscapes, mountain trails, peaceful escapes, and exciting outdoor experiences.
services.description: Reconnect with nature through memorable outdoor journeys. Whether you love mountain scenery, hiking trails, quiet countryside escapes, or discovering hidden destinations, we help you plan experiences that bring you closer to the natural world.
services.imageAlt: Travelers exploring a scenic mountain trail
benefits: Discover beautiful places beyond the usual routes
Choose experiences suited to your interests

services.title: Travel Assistance
services.subtitle: We're here to help
services.shortDescription: Get practical guidance and booking assistance to make organizing your journey easier.
services.description: Planning a trip can involve many details. Our travel assistance service helps you navigate travel arrangements, understand your itinerary, coordinate schedules, and get answers to questions before your journey begins.
services.imageAlt: Travel consultant assisting customers with travel arrangements
features: Help understanding booking changes and policies
benefits: Less stress when organizing your trip
Helpful guidance throughout the planning process

services.title: Tour Packages
services.subtitle: Discover more, together
services.shortDescription: Explore thoughtfully planned tour packages for families, couples, groups, and curious travelers.
services.description: Discover destinations with tour packages that bring together sightseeing, travel routes, activities, and suggested itineraries. Choose a ready-made travel experience or ask us to customize a package around your schedule and budget.
services.imageAlt: Beautiful travel destination with mountains and a scenic lake
benefits: More time to enjoy your destination

process.description: A simple process helps you turn your travel dreams into a well-planned journey.

steps.title: Share Your Ideas
steps.description: Tell us your preferred destination, travel dates, budget, and the experiences you enjoy.

steps.title: Customize Your Plan
steps.description: Explore suitable destinations, activities, routes, and itinerary options.

steps.title: Confirm Your Journey
steps.description: Review the proposed arrangements, costs, and booking details before confirming.

steps.title: Enjoy the Experience
steps.description: Set off on your adventure with your travel plan ready and the details organized.

cta.description: Tell us what your ideal journey looks like, and let's start creating a travel experience made for you.
